children: An unknown attacker breached the Fogo Foundation and transferred about 400 million FOGO tokens to a malicious address. According to ChainCatcher, the foundation has notified major exchanges and is communicating with law enforcement and blockchain forensics experts.
The incident does not affect the Fogo blockchain itself, and the network remains operational. The Fogo Foundation said it will release further updates once more information becomes available.

title: Unknown Attacker Transfers 400 Million FOGO Tokens From Fogo Foundation
